title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta9

## Scheduler V2 practical completion

This beta fixes a field regression where a Navimow zone could finish at 99%,
leave mowing normally, and then be started again by Scheduler V2 instead of
advancing to the next configured queue slot.

The captured H2 case was **Street2**: the vendor ended the practical mowing
cycle at 99%, but ZoneLedger intentionally kept strict public completion at
100%. Scheduler V2 only watched that strict timestamp, kept slot 0 unfinished,
and later sent an exact-zone continue back to Street2.

### Practical 95-99% completion

Scheduler V2 now has a second, deliberately narrow completion path for the
vendor behavior already recognized elsewhere in the integration:

- current per-zone vendor coverage is at least the vendor practical completion
  threshold (95%);
- progress is still below 100%, so the strict 100% path remains authoritative
  whenever it exists;
- the mower has actually left cutting and is **Returning** or **Docked**;
- the coverage row is fresh and belongs to the task started after this scheduler
  dispatch;
- there is no positive interruption evidence.

When all of that is true, the current queue slot is considered complete and V2
advances exactly as it would after a strict 100% completion.

### Interruption safety remains explicit

Practical completion is refused when the mower stopped because of:

- low battery / charging;
- rain or another vendor weather/task delay;
- night hold;
- mower error/problem;
- explicit pause evidence.

The return-to-dock battery threshold is also used as a low-battery guard when
notification evidence is unavailable.

### Do not Resume while Returning

Beta8 could also reach the unfinished-slot resume path while the mower was still
Returning, because charging readiness only becomes meaningful after the mower
actually reaches the charging state.

Beta9 now waits through Returning:

- normal 95-99% completion is resolved first and advances to the next slot;
- an interrupted return remains unfinished;
- Resume/one-zone continue is considered only after the return has settled into
  the appropriate dock/charging state.

No Map Card update is required. Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta7 remains the
matching frontend for the current 0.5.0 beta line.
